title: Jorge was an incredible...
text: Jorge was an incredible teacher and such a warming guy. The drinks before and after got us in the mood and took some nerves away. The lesson was terrific and we learned a few moves. We did only learn one specific dance, but that’s enough for the time being. Highly recommend!
author: Joris_B

title: Great experience!
text: Paula and Jorge were great...fun...patient! Fun group of people.
author: Eric D

title: Beautiful experience with incredible teachers!!
text: This was the most enriching and moving experience. My husband and I loved every second of it and we were so proud of ourselves at the end. The teachers, Paula and Jorge, were so kind and patient and know how to get the best out of people. We had zero previous dancing experience and by the end of the hour and a half, we were able to tango with some reasonable degree of talent haha. It was a beautiful and emotional experience and we would absolutely recommend this to anyone!!
author: VictoriaLynn_T

title: Great tango lesson!
text:
Amazing dance lesson! Our teacher was super nice and very good at explaining things in an easy way! She was patient and did her best to make this a very fun experience!
Definitely recommend :)
author: sabine a

title: I highly recommend! Super...
text: I highly recommend! Super friendly, explain the history of tango, excellent activity to do in a couple or with friends. We love it!
author: Sara_S

title: Birthday gift
text: This was a birthday gift to my son Floris and his girlfriend Heloisa. They had a blast learning how to tango together.
author: Monika_H

title: Tango Class
text: Although tango is not a Spanish dance, it's Argentinian, this class was so much fun. Our instructor gave clear directions and wasn't afraid to make us laugh at ourselves. My husband and I really enjoyed this class and want to keep practicing our tango because of it. I was ~5 months pregnant and this class was still so fun!
author: Christopher_H

title: Great Experience
text: I totally enjoyed myself. Paula is excellent. Instructions were simple, history was given. Fun was had and the Sangria was delicious. Thank you Paula!!!
author: Cynthia_F

title: Fab way to spend an hour...
text: Fab way to spend an hour during our trip To Barcelona. Dance instructor made everybody feel at ease.
author: dawnstokes1

title: Great time
text: So much fun! Our hosts/instructors were so like-able and personable. They learned everybody’s name and made us feel very comfortable learning Tango! A lot of history and information, as well as dancing and Sangria! Also, the neighborhood around the location was gorgeous and featured a-lot of boutiques that we were able to walk and explore after dancing. Won major points with my lady :) Thank you so much Paula
author: MariahCJ
